hypotheses.justification: `hS` is implied by the hypothesis `hg : ∀ u, |g u| ≤ S`: the domain `ℝ × JetPrototype.Phase` is nonempty (`JetPrototype.Phase = (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)`), so for any `u₀` we get `0 ≤ |g u₀| ≤ S`, i.e. `(abs_nonneg _).trans (hg u₀)`. So the statement with `hS` deleted is literally the same statement. In the proof only `continuousOn_size`/`time_difference` need `0 ≤ S` (for the `NNReal` constant `⟨L*R+S, _⟩` and for `mul_nonneg`), and there the derived proof can be passed; note that `PositiveIntegral.along_time_bound` already takes it as `_hS` (unused).

Likewise `hR` follows from `hfB : ∀ u, |f u| ≤ R` evaluated at any point of the nonempty type `ℝ × JetPrototype.Phase`, giving `0 ≤ |f u₀| ≤ R`. Deleting it leaves the same proposition; in the proof the only uses of `0 ≤ R` are the nonnegativity of the Lipschitz constant `L*R+S` in `continuousOn_size` (via `time_difference`, where `PositiveIntegral.along_time_bound` again has `_hR` unused), and the derived proof can be supplied there. (Deletable independently of `hS`.)

If `T < 0` then `PositiveIntegral.time T t = max 0 (min T t) = 0` for every `t` (as `min T t ≤ T < 0`), so unfolding `PositiveIntegral.value` gives `value T L flight f₀ g (t,p) = Real.exp (-L*0) * f₀ (flight (-0) p) + ∫ r in 0..0, ... = f₀ (flight 0 p)`, which is independent of `t`. Hence by `hf` the function `t ↦ size (fun p => f (t,p))` is constant, hence continuous. So the statement still holds when `hT` is removed (proof by `by_cases hT : 0 ≤ T`; in the `0 ≤ T` branch use the existing argument).

The sign of `L` is used only to bound the exponential weights; the conclusion is true for any real `L` (with `hT` kept). The restarting identity of `PositiveIntegral.restart` is purely algebraic (`flight_add`, `exp_add`, `ring`); its only `hL`-dependent input is interval-integrability of `r ↦ e^{-L(t-r)} g (r, flight (r-t) p)`, which for arbitrary `L` follows from `hgm`/`hg` since `|e^{-L(t-r)}| ≤ e^{|L|T}` on `r ∈ [0,t]`. Then for `0 ≤ s ≤ t ≤ T`, using `|e^{x}-1| ≤ e^{|x|}|x|`, `|f (t,p) - f (s, flight (s-t) p)| ≤ (e^{|L|T}|L|R + e^{|L|T}S)(t-s)`, and `size_difference` (with the `NNReal` constant `e^{|L|T}(|L|R+S)`) yields the Lipschitz bound on `Icc 0 T`; the rest of the proof (`time_idempotent`, `PositiveIntegral.time_bounds`, composition with the continuous clamp) is unchanged, so continuity holds for negative `L` as well.
